# API Reference

Version 1.0.0

## Overview

This document describes the public API for the library.

## Installation

```bash
npm install mdpdf-core
```

## Quick Start

```javascript
import { createPdfEngine } from 'mdpdf-core';

const engine = createPdfEngine();
const pdf = await engine.render('# Hello World');
```

## API Reference

### `createPdfEngine(options?)`

Creates a new PDF engine instance.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| pageSize | string | 'A4' | Paper size |
| margins | object | {...} | Page margins |
| outline | boolean | true | Generate outline |

**Returns:** `PdfEngine`

**Example:**

```javascript
const engine = createPdfEngine({
  pageSize: 'LETTER',
  margins: { top: 72, right: 72, bottom: 72, left: 72 }
});
```

### `engine.render(markdown, options?)`

Renders markdown to PDF bytes.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| markdown | string | Markdown content |
| options.title | string | Document title |
| options.author | string | Document author |

**Returns:** `Promise<Uint8Array>`

## Error Handling

The engine throws the following errors:

- `MdpdfError` - General PDF generation error
- `TypeError` - Invalid parameter type

```javascript
try {
  const pdf = await engine.render(markdown);
} catch (error) {
  if (error.name === 'MdpdfError') {
    console.error('PDF generation failed:', error.message);
  }
}
```
